Messages.Author: YY
Messages.Body:
I came across a scenario last night regarding Yawp Court and Psyche!.

Scenario:
- Vamp A takes a successful political action, Vamp B enters combat
with A using Yawp Court.
- A plays an s:ce, B plays Psyche!

Does B take the 2 damage from Yawp Court at this point?

Continuing from the scenario:
- In the second combat, A plays another s:ce, and B plays another
Psyche!

Does B take the 2 damage from Yawp Court again?
If the same thing happens for a few more combats, would B take 2
damage each time?

Cheers,

Y.Y.

Oops, forgot to quote the card text.

Psyche!
Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Celerity
[cel] Press.
[CEL] Only usable at the end of combat when both combatants are still
ready. Begin another combat with the opposing minion.

Yawp Court
Cardtype: Master
Master: unique location. Requires a ready Sabbat vampire.
When a political action is successful, before the referendum, [tap
this card and a ready untapped Sabbat vampire you control] to have
that vampire enter combat with the acting vampire. If the acting
vampire is still ready at the end of combat, the Sabbat vampire takes
2 damage, and the referendum is conducted as normal.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Tue, 6 Oct 2009 18:25:40 -0700 (PDT), YY wrote:

>I came across a scenario last night regarding Yawp Court and Psyche!.

>Scenario:
>- Vamp A takes a successful political action, Vamp B enters combat
>with A using Yawp Court.
>- A plays an s:ce, B plays Psyche!

>Does B take the 2 damage from Yawp Court at this point?

Yes.

>Continuing from the scenario:
>- In the second combat, A plays another s:ce, and B plays another
>Psyche!

>Does B take the 2 damage from Yawp Court again?

No.
This second combat is not the Yawp Court combat.

>If the same thing happens for a few more combats, would B take 2
>damage each time?

No.
Never again after the first combat.
